entwurf.beschreibung: Gemini Notebook empowers researchers with AI summaries, code execution, and seamless sync across devices, while outlining its enterprise options and beta limitations.

teile.name: Intro
teile.suche: Gemini Notebook summary, AI research tool
teile.szene: A dimly lit study room. A lone student sits at a desk, surrounded by scattered papers. The glow of a laptop screen illuminates their face as they open a Gemini Notebook window. Soft rain taps the window, adding a rhythmic backdrop.
teile.text: Tired of endless research piles? Gemini Notebook turns papers into concise AI summaries for quick understanding.
teile.bildtext: Student surrounded by papers, laptop glowing

teile.name: Upload
teile.suche: Gemini Notebook upload PDF, audio overview
teile.szene: The same study room. The student drags a PDF file into the Gemini Notebook interface. The screen shows a progress bar and a voice icon appearing next to the document. Outside, a window shows a clear night sky.
teile.text: Upload PDFs, let Gemini scan, then listen to audio overviews that fit your study rhythm daily.
teile.bildtext: PDF being uploaded, voice icon appears

teile.name: Run Code
teile.suche: Gemini Notebook run code, data analysis
teile.szene: The screen now shows a code cell in a notebook. Lines of Python run, outputting a line chart. The student watches the graph update in real time, a look of satisfaction on their face. The room remains quiet except for a soft hum of the computer.
teile.text: Run code in a notebook; analyze data, plot charts, and see results instantly on the fly.

teile.name: Sync
teile.szene: A split-screen: one side shows the Gemini app on a phone, another shows the Google Search interface with a notebook preview. Lines of data sync between the apps, and the student nods approvingly as the note updates appear instantly on both screens.
teile.text: Sync notes across the Gemini app, Google Search, and the standalone notebook for seamless access.

teile.name: Enterprise
teile.szene: A corporate meeting room. A team of researchers huddle around a screen displaying a Gemini Notebook dashboard. Icons of advanced Gemini models appear, and a bar graph shows increased productivity. The atmosphere is focused and optimistic.
teile.text: Enterprise plans unlock premium Gemini models; Pro users will receive full code execution soon tomorrow.

teile.name: Limits
teile.szene: A close-up of the notebook interface where an error message pops up. The student leans forward, reading the message. Outside, a clock ticks, reminding of time spent debugging. The scene emphasizes caution and verification.
teile.text: Code execution is available to users; verify outputs before sharing, as occasional errors still occur.

teile.name: Engage
teile.szene: The student smiles at the camera, holding a tablet showing the Gemini Notebook logo. The background is a tidy desk with a plant. The scene invites viewers to engage with the content.
teile.text: Be sure to like, share, and save this video.
